0. Setup & Helper Functions (from NB-01 to NB-07)

library(tidyverse)
library(quanteda)
library(glmnet)
library(rsample)
library(yardstick)
library(stringr)
library(patchwork)

SEED <- 42
set.seed(SEED)
mod05_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "mod05")
dir.create(mod05_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

theme_set(
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks       = element_line(colour = "grey40")
    )
)

# ── Abbreviation expansion (NB-01) ───────────────────────────────────────────
abbrevs <- c(
  DM2 = "type 2 diabetes", HTN = "hypertension", HF = "heart failure",
  CKD = "chronic kidney disease", COPD = "chronic obstructive pulmonary disease",
  PE = "pulmonary embolism", SOB = "shortness of breath", CP = "chest pain",
  HR = "heart rate", BP = "blood pressure", SpO2 = "oxygen saturation",
  EF = "ejection fraction", BNP = "brain natriuretic peptide",
  PO = "by mouth", IV = "intravenous", BID = "twice daily", QD = "once daily",
  Pt = "patient", pt = "patient"
)
expand_abbrevs <- function(text) {
  ord <- order(nchar(names(abbrevs)), decreasing = TRUE)
  for (i in ord) {
    pattern <- paste0("\\b", names(abbrevs)[i], "\\b")
    text <- stringr::str_replace_all(text, stringr::regex(pattern), unname(abbrevs[i]))
  }
  text
}

# ── PHI de-identification (NB-01) ───────────────────────────────────────────
phi_pats <- c(
  MRN  = "MRN\\s*:\\s*\\d{6,10}",
  DATE = "\\b\\d{1,2}/\\d{1,2}/\\d{4}\\b",
  AGE  = "\\b\\d{2,3}\\s*(?:y/o|year[-\\s]old|yo)\\b"
)
deidentify <- function(text) {
  for (t in names(phi_pats)) {
    text <- stringr::str_replace_all(
      text, stringr::regex(phi_pats[[t]], ignore_case = TRUE), paste0("[", t, "]")
    )
  }
  text
}

# ── Vital/lab extraction (NB-01) ─────────────────────────────────────────────
vital_pats <- c(
  hr   = "HR\\s*:?\\s*(\\d{2,3})",
  sbp  = "BP\\s*:?\\s*(\\d{2,3})/(\\d{2,3})",
  spo2 = "SpO2\\s*:?\\s*(\\d{2,3})\\s*%",
  bnp  = "BNP\\s*(\\d{2,5})",
  cr   = "Cr\\s*(\\d\\.\\d)",
  ef   = "EF\\s*(\\d{2})\\s*%"
)
extract_vitals <- function(text) {
  vals <- list()
  for (name in names(vital_pats)) {
    m <- stringr::str_match(text, stringr::regex(vital_pats[[name]], ignore_case = TRUE))
    if (!is.na(m[1, 1])) {
      vals[[name]] <- as.numeric(if (name == "sbp") m[1, 2] else m[1, 2])
    }
  }
  vals
}

# ── NER (NB-02) ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
entity_pats <- list(
  DISEASE = c("heart failure", "diabetes", "COPD", "sepsis", "pneumonia",
              "pulmonary embolism", "DKA", "ketoacidosis", "hypertension",
              "acute kidney injury", "myocardial infarction", "atrial fibrillation"),
  DRUG    = c("furosemide", "metformin", "insulin", "albuterol", "vancomycin",
              "carvedilol", "lisinopril", "sacubitril", "methylprednisolone",
              "ceftriaxone", "rivaroxaban", "aspirin", "spironolactone"),
  FINDING = c("bilateral pitting edema", "reduced ejection fraction", "hypercapnia",
              "volume overload", "bilateral infiltrates", "anion gap", "ST elevation")
)
count_ents <- function(text) {
  counts <- list()
  for (label in names(entity_pats)) {
    n <- 0L
    for (p in entity_pats[[label]]) {
      regex <- paste0("\\b", stringr::str_replace_all(p, "([\\W])", "\\\\\\1"), "\\b")
      if (stringr::str_detect(text, stringr::regex(regex, ignore_case = TRUE))) n <- n + 1L
    }
    counts[[label]] <- n
  }
  counts
}

# ── ICD-10 suggester (NB-06) ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
icd10_ref <- tibble::tibble(
  code = c("I50.9", "J44.1", "E11.10", "A41.9", "J18.9"),
  desc = c("Heart failure", "COPD exacerbation", "DKA T2DM", "Sepsis", "Pneumonia"),
  kw   = c(
    "heart failure BNP furosemide edema ejection fraction",
    "COPD exacerbation bronchospasm albuterol wheezes steroids",
    "diabetic ketoacidosis DKA anion gap insulin glucose acidosis",
    "sepsis septic shock bacteremia lactate norepinephrine broad spectrum",
    "pneumonia consolidation fever antibiotics ceftriaxone WBC"
  )
)
icd_texts <- paste(icd10_ref$kw, icd10_ref$desc)
toks_icd <- quanteda::tokens(icd_texts, remove_punct = TRUE) |>
  quanteda::tokens_tolower() |>
  quanteda::tokens_ngrams(n = 1:2)
dfm_icd <- quanteda::dfm_tfidf(quanteda::dfm(toks_icd))
if (nfeat(dfm_icd) > 200) {
  keep <- names(quanteda::topfeatures(dfm_icd, n = 200))
  dfm_icd <- quanteda::dfm_select(dfm_icd, pattern = keep)
}
icd_mat <- as.matrix(dfm_icd)

suggest_top1 <- function(text) {
  toks <- quanteda::tokens(tolower(text), remove_punct = TRUE) |>
    quanteda::tokens_ngrams(n = 1:2)
  d <- quanteda::dfm_match(quanteda::dfm(toks), features = colnames(icd_mat))
  vec <- as.numeric(as.matrix(d))
  nrms <- sqrt(rowSums(icd_mat^2)); nrms[nrms == 0] <- 1
  vn <- sqrt(sum(vec^2)); if (vn == 0) vn <- 1
  scores <- as.numeric((icd_mat / nrms) %*% (vec / vn))
  icd10_ref$code[which.max(scores)]
}

fill_template <- function(tmpl) {

2. NLP Feature Pipeline

stops <- c("patient", "the", "a", "an", "was", "were", "for", "and", "or", "with",

                 "bnp_extracted", "cr_extracted", "ef_extracted", "spo2_extracted")

set.seed(SEED)
split <- rsample::initial_split(df, prop = 0.80, strata = readmitted)
train <- rsample::training(split)
test  <- rsample::testing(split)

make_tfidf <- function(texts, train_dfm = NULL) {
  texts <- as.character(texts)
  names(texts) <- paste0("doc", seq_along(texts))
  toks <- quanteda::tokens(texts, remove_punct = TRUE) |>
    quanteda::tokens_tolower() |>
    quanteda::tokens_remove(stops) |>
    quanteda::tokens_ngrams(n = 1:2)
  d <- quanteda::dfm(toks)
  if (is.null(train_dfm)) {
    keep_n <- min(500L, nfeat(d))
    keep <- names(quanteda::topfeatures(d, n = keep_n))
    d <- quanteda::dfm_select(d, pattern = keep)
    quanteda::dfm_tfidf(d)
  } else {
    d <- quanteda::dfm_match(d, features = quanteda::featnames(train_dfm))
    quanteda::dfm_tfidf(d)
  }
}

dtr <- make_tfidf(train$text)
dte <- make_tfidf(test$text, train_dfm = dtr)
x_tr_tfidf <- as.matrix(dtr)
x_te_tfidf <- as.matrix(dte)

impute_median <- function(x) {
  x[is.na(x)] <- median(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  x
}
scale_mat <- function(tr, te) {
  tr <- apply(tr, 2, impute_median)
  te <- apply(te, 2, impute_median)
  mu <- colMeans(tr); sdv <- apply(tr, 2, sd); sdv[sdv == 0] <- 1
  list(tr = scale(tr, center = mu, scale = sdv),
       te = scale(te, center = mu, scale = sdv))
}
sc <- scale_mat(as.matrix(train[, struct_cols]), as.matrix(test[, struct_cols]))
x_tr_struct <- sc$tr
x_te_struct <- sc$te

5. Extraction Rate Analysis

stops_summ <- c(quanteda::stopwords("en"),
                "patient", "mg", "daily", "was", "were", "the", "a", "an",
                "admission", "discharge", "hospital")

split_sentences <- function(text) {
  sents <- unlist(quanteda::tokens(text, what = "sentence"))
  sents <- stringr::str_squish(sents)
  n_words <- vapply(strsplit(sents, "\\s+"), length, integer(1))
  sents[n_words > 5]
}

textrank_summarise <- function(text, n_sents = 4) {
  sents <- split_sentences(text)
  if (length(sents) <= n_sents) return(sents)
  toks <- quanteda::tokens(sents, remove_punct = TRUE) |>
    quanteda::tokens_tolower() |>
    quanteda::tokens_remove(stops_summ)
  d <- quanteda::dfm_tfidf(quanteda::dfm(toks))
  mat <- as.matrix(d)
  if (nrow(mat) == 0 || ncol(mat) == 0) return(sents[seq_len(n_sents)])
  nrms <- sqrt(rowSums(mat^2)); nrms[nrms == 0] <- 1
  sim <- tcrossprod(mat / nrms); diag(sim) <- 0
  n <- nrow(sim)
  scores <- rep(1 / n, n)
  for (iter in seq_len(50)) {
    rs <- rowSums(sim); rs[rs == 0] <- 1
    scores <- 0.15 / n + 0.85 * as.numeric(t(sim / rs) %*% scores)
  }
  sents[sort(order(scores, decreasing = TRUE)[seq_len(n_sents)])]
}

title: Capstone · End-to-End Clinical NLP Pipeline
text:
8. Methods Narrative (Template)

Clinical NLP Methods
Discharge summaries (N=400) were preprocessed through a rule-based pipeline: PHI de-identification (regex for MRN, dates, ages), clinical abbreviation expansion (20-term dictionary), and section header extraction (8 section types).
Named entities were identified using a lexicon-based gazetteer (EntityRuler analogue) with 40+ clinical patterns across 3 entity types (DISEASE, DRUG, FINDING) with window-based negation detection (5-token look-back window). Structured values (BNP, creatinine, EF, SpO2) were extracted using clinical measurement regex patterns.
ICD-10 code suggestions were generated via cosine similarity between TF-IDF representations of note text and ICD-10 keyword descriptions (top-1 accuracy: XX%). Medication extraction used a drug name lexicon (80+ drugs) with dose/route/frequency capture patterns.
Readmission prediction compared three feature sets: (1) structured NLP-extracted values only, (2) TF-IDF unigram+bigram features, and (3) hybrid TF-IDF + structured — all trained with logistic regression (glmnet, balanced via intercept). Extractive summarisation used TextRank with cosine-similarity-based sentence scoring.
All analyses used R 4.3+ (quanteda, tidytext, glmnet, text2vec, stringr).

text:
2. TF-IDF ICD-10 Code Suggester

icd_texts <- paste(icd10_ref$kw, icd10_ref$desc)
toks_icd <- quanteda::tokens(icd_texts, remove_punct = TRUE) |>
  quanteda::tokens_tolower() |>
  quanteda::tokens_ngrams(n = 1:2)
dfm_icd <- quanteda::dfm_tfidf(quanteda::dfm(toks_icd))
if (nfeat(dfm_icd) > 500) {
  keep <- names(quanteda::topfeatures(dfm_icd, n = 500))
  dfm_icd <- quanteda::dfm_select(dfm_icd, pattern = keep)
}
icd_matrix <- as.matrix(dfm_icd)

cosine_rows <- function(vec, mat) {
  nrms <- sqrt(rowSums(mat^2)); nrms[nrms == 0] <- 1
  vn <- sqrt(sum(vec^2)); if (vn == 0) vn <- 1
  as.numeric((mat / nrms) %*% (vec / vn))
}

suggest_icd <- function(text, top_k = 5, threshold = 0.12) {
  toks <- quanteda::tokens(tolower(text), remove_punct = TRUE) |>
    quanteda::tokens_ngrams(n = 1:2)
  d <- quanteda::dfm_match(quanteda::dfm(toks), features = colnames(icd_matrix))
  vec <- as.numeric(as.matrix(d))
  scores <- cosine_rows(vec, icd_matrix)
  top_idx <- order(scores, decreasing = TRUE)[seq_len(top_k)]
  keep <- top_idx[scores[top_idx] >= threshold]
  tibble::tibble(
    code  = icd10_ref$code[keep],
    desc  = icd10_ref$desc[keep],
    score = round(scores[keep], 3)
  )
}

# Longest names first so "insulin glargine" matches before "insulin"
drug_list <- drug_list[order(nchar(drug_list), decreasing = TRUE)]

dose_unit <- "(?:mg|mcg|g|mL|units?|IU|mEq)"
route_pat <- "(?:PO|IV|IM|SQ|SC|SL|inhaled|topical|PR)"
freq_pat  <- "(?:QD|BID|TID|QID|QAM|QHS|q\\d+h|PRN|once daily|twice daily|daily|weekly)"
drug_pat  <- paste0("\\b(", paste(stringr::str_replace_all(drug_list, "([\\W])", "\\\\\\1"),
                                  collapse = "|"), ")\\b")
med_pat <- paste0(
  drug_pat,
  "(?:[\\s,]+(\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?)\\s*(", dose_unit, "))?",
  "(?:[\\s,]+(", route_pat, "))?",
  "(?:[\\s,]+(", freq_pat, "))?"
)

extract_meds <- function(text) {
  m <- stringr::str_match_all(text, stringr::regex(med_pat, ignore_case = TRUE))[[1]]
  if (nrow(m) == 0) {
    return(tibble::tibble(drug = character(), dose = character(), unit = character(),
                          route = character(), freq = character()))
  }
  out <- tibble::tibble(
    drug  = tolower(m[, 2]),
    dose  = ifelse(is.na(m[, 3]), "", stringr::str_squish(m[, 3])),
    unit  = ifelse(is.na(m[, 4]), "", stringr::str_squish(m[, 4])),
    route = toupper(ifelse(is.na(m[, 5]), "", m[, 5])),
    freq  = toupper(ifelse(is.na(m[, 6]), "", m[, 6]))
  )
  dplyr::distinct(out, drug, .keep_all = TRUE)
}

text:
4. Medication Reconciliation

reconcile_medications <- function(admit_text, dc_text) {
  admit_meds <- extract_meds(admit_text)
  dc_meds    <- extract_meds(dc_text)
  admit_set  <- admit_meds$drug
  dc_set     <- dc_meds$drug
  continued    <- sort(intersect(admit_set, dc_set))
  discontinued <- sort(setdiff(admit_set, dc_set))
  new_at_dc    <- sort(setdiff(dc_set, admit_set))
  dose_changed <- continued[purrr::map_lgl(continued, function(d) {
    a <- admit_meds$dose[admit_meds$drug == d]
    b <- dc_meds$dose[dc_meds$drug == d]
    nzchar(a) && nzchar(b) && a != b
  })]
  list(
    continued = continued, discontinued = discontinued,
    new_at_dc = new_at_dc, dose_changed = dose_changed,
    admit_meds = admit_meds, dc_meds = dc_meds
  )
}

validate_icd <- function(code) {
  code <- toupper(stringr::str_squish(as.character(code)))

    valid_format = valid,

# Exercise 5 — dose range validation
dose_limits_oral <- list(
  metformin    = c(250, 2550),
  furosemide   = c(20, 600),
  lisinopril   = c(2.5, 40),
  warfarin     = c(1, 15),
  aspirin      = c(81, 325),
  atorvastatin = c(10, 80)
)

validate_doses <- function(text) {
  meds <- extract_meds(text)
  flags <- list()
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(meds))) {
    m <- meds[i, ]
    if (m$drug %in% names(dose_limits_oral) && nzchar(m$dose) &&
        m$route %in% c("PO", "")) {
      dose <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(m$dose))
      if (is.na(dose)) next
      lim <- dose_limits_oral[[m$drug]]
      if (!(lim[1] <= dose && dose <= lim[2])) {
        flags[[length(flags) + 1]] <- tibble::tibble(
          drug = m$drug, dose = dose, unit = m$unit,
          expected = sprintf("%s-%s mg", lim[1], lim[2]),
          flag = if (dose > lim[2]) "ABOVE MAX" else "BELOW MIN"
        )
      }
    }
  }
  if (length(flags) == 0) {
    return(tibble::tibble(drug = character(), dose = numeric(), unit = character(),
                          expected = character(), flag = character()))
  }
  dplyr::bind_rows(flags)
}

text:
3. Train Clinical Word2Vec
text2vec trains GloVe embeddings from a skip-gram co-occurrence matrix — the standard R analogue of gensim Word2Vec. Skip-gram window = 5 matches the Python demo.

train_glove <- function(token_list, window = 5L, rank = 30L, n_iter = 15L,
                        min_count = 2L, x_max = 100, learning_rate = 0.01) {
  it <- text2vec::itoken(token_list, progressbar = FALSE)
  vocab <- text2vec::create_vocabulary(it) |>
    text2vec::prune_vocabulary(term_count_min = min_count)
  vectorizer <- text2vec::vocab_vectorizer(vocab)
  it2 <- text2vec::itoken(token_list, progressbar = FALSE)
  tcm <- text2vec::create_tcm(it2, vectorizer, skip_grams_window = window)
  rank_use <- max(2L, min(rank, nrow(tcm) - 1L))
  tryCatch({
    glove <- text2vec::GlobalVectors$new(rank = rank_use, x_max = x_max)
    wv_main <- glove$fit_transform(
      tcm, n_iter = n_iter, convergence_tol = 0.05,
      n_threads = 1, learning_rate = learning_rate
    )
    wv_main + t(glove$components)
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("GloVe optimiser unstable; using SVD of the co-occurrence matrix.\n")
    mat <- as.matrix(tcm)
    mat[!is.finite(mat)] <- 0
    s <- svd(mat, nu = rank_use, nv = rank_use)
    out <- s$u %*% diag(sqrt(pmax(s$d[seq_len(rank_use)], 0)), rank_use, rank_use)
    rownames(out) <- rownames(tcm)
    out
  })
}

cosine_sim <- function(a, b) {
  sum(a * b) / (sqrt(sum(a^2)) * sqrt(sum(b^2)) + 1e-12)
}

most_similar <- function(word_vectors, word, topn = 4) {
  if (!word %in% rownames(word_vectors)) return(NULL)
  target <- word_vectors[word, ]
  sims <- apply(word_vectors, 1, cosine_sim, b = target)
  sims <- sims[names(sims) != word]
  sims <- sort(sims, decreasing = TRUE)
  head(sims, topn)
}

wv <- train_glove(augmented, window = 5L, min_count = 2L)
cat(sprintf("Vocabulary: %d tokens | Dim: %d\n", nrow(wv), ncol(wv)))

Vocabulary: 222 tokens | Dim: 30

cat("\nSemantic similarity examples:\n")

  if (!is.null(sims)) {
    labelled <- paste0(names(sims), "(", sprintf("%.2f", sims), ")")
    cat(sprintf("  %-15s: %s\n", word, paste(labelled, collapse = ", ")))
  }
}

  Diabetes  = c("diabetes insulin HbA1c metformin glucose ketoacidosis anion gap",
                "hypoglycemia dextrose glucagon blood sugar altered mental status",
                "diabetic foot infection wound amputation vascular antibiotics"),
  Renal     = c("acute kidney injury creatinine nephrotoxins dialysis hemodialysis",
                "proteinuria nephrotic syndrome albumin diuretics renal biopsy",
                "UTI pyuria culture E coli trimethoprim nitrofurantoin"),

doc_data <- purrr::imap_dfr(condition_templates, function(templates, cond) {
  purrr::map_dfr(seq_len(80), function(i) {
    base <- tokenize_note(sample(templates, 1))
    noise <- sample(c("patient", "treatment", "management", "hospital"), 2, replace = TRUE)
    tokens <- sample(c(base, noise))
    tibble::tibble(tokens = list(tokens), condition = cond)
  })
})

get_doc_vector <- function(tokens, word_vectors, dim = 100) {
  keep <- tokens[tokens %in% rownames(word_vectors)]
  if (length(keep) == 0) return(rep(0, dim))
  colMeans(word_vectors[keep, , drop = FALSE])
}

Skip-gram (window = 5, predicting context from the target) vs a CBOW-like narrower window (window = 2). Both are trained as GloVe on skip-gram co-occurrence matrices — the text2vec analogue of gensim’s sg=1 vs sg=0.

6. NER Evaluation

evaluate_ner <- function(gold_list, pred_df) {
  gold_text <- unique(purrr::map_chr(gold_list, ~ paste(tolower(.x[1]), .x[2], sep = "||")))
  pred_text <- unique(paste(tolower(pred_df$text), pred_df$label, sep = "||"))
  parse_pair <- function(x) {
    parts <- strsplit(x, "\\|\\|", perl = TRUE)
    tibble::tibble(
      span  = vapply(parts, `[`, character(1), 1),
      etype = vapply(parts, `[`, character(1), 2)
    )
  }
  gold_df <- parse_pair(gold_text)
  pred_p  <- parse_pair(pred_text)
  all_types <- union(gold_df$etype, pred_p$etype)
  purrr::map_dfr(all_types, function(etype) {
    g <- gold_df$span[gold_df$etype == etype]
    p <- pred_p$span[pred_p$etype == etype]
    tp <- length(intersect(g, p))
    fp <- length(setdiff(p, g))
    fn <- length(setdiff(g, p))
    prec <- if ((tp + fp) > 0) tp / (tp + fp) else 0
    rec  <- if ((tp + fn) > 0) tp / (tp + fn) else 0
    f1   <- if ((prec + rec) > 0) 2 * prec * rec / (prec + rec) else 0
    tibble::tibble(
      type = etype, TP = tp, FP = fp, FN = fn,
      Precision = round(prec, 3), Recall = round(rec, 3), F1 = round(f1, 3)
    )
  })
}

brier_prob <- function(y, p) mean((p - y)^2)
sig <- function(x) 1 / (1 + exp(-x))
clip <- function(x, lo, hi) pmin(pmax(x, lo), hi)

# ── Build dataset ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
set.seed(SEED); N <- 3500
b <- matrix(rnorm(N * 4), ncol = 4); set.seed(99)
age <- as.integer(clip(rnorm(N, 62, 15), 18, 92))
sex <- sample(c("M", "F"), N, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.48, 0.52))
payer <- sample(c("Medicare", "Medicaid", "Private", "Self-pay", "Other"),
                N, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.40, 0.22, 0.28, 0.07, 0.03))
admit_type <- sample(c("Emergency", "Elective", "Urgent"),
                     N, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.52, 0.30, 0.18))
los_days <- as.integer(clip(round(rgamma(N, shape = 2.5, scale = 1.8)), 1, 30))
diabetes <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.6 * b[, 1] - 0.5 + 0.02 * (age - 62) / 15))
hypertension <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.7 * b[, 1] - 0.2))
hf <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.4 * b[, 2] + 0.5 * hypertension - 1.5))
copd <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.5 * b[, 3] - 1.0))
ckd <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.5 * b[, 1] + 0.6 * diabetes - 1.2))
obesity <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.5 * b[, 1] - 0.8))
depression <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.3 * b[, 4] - 1.4))
n_comorb <- diabetes + hypertension + hf + copd + ckd
set.seed(21)
glucose <- round(clip(rnorm(N, 105 + 15 * diabetes, 28), 50, 400), 1)
creatinine <- round(clip(rgamma(N, shape = 1.6 + 0.8 * hf, scale = 0.6), 0.4, 10), 2)
hba1c <- round(clip(rnorm(N, 6.5 + 0.8 * diabetes, 1.4), 4, 14), 1)
sbp <- round(clip(rnorm(N, 128 + 12 * hypertension, 18), 80, 200), 0)
bmi <- round(clip(rnorm(N, 28 + 4 * obesity, 6), 15, 55), 1)
logit <- (-3.2 + 0.6 * hf + 0.5 * diabetes + 0.5 * ckd + 0.3 * copd +
            0.02 * (age - 62) / 15 +
            0.3 * as.integer(admit_type == "Emergency") +
            0.25 * as.integer(payer == "Medicaid") +
            0.2 * as.integer(los_days > 7) +
            0.5 * hf * diabetes + rnorm(N, 0, 0.25))
readmitted <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(logit))
start <- as.Date("2019-01-01"); set.seed(5)
admit_dates <- start + sample.int(as.integer(as.Date("2023-12-31") - start), N, replace = TRUE)

) %>% arrange(admit_date)

4. Bayesian Fine-Tuning of Best Model

set.seed(SEED)

xgb_spec <- boost_tree(
  trees = tune(), tree_depth = tune(), learn_rate = tune(),
  sample_size = tune(), min_n = tune()
) %>% set_engine("xgboost") %>% set_mode("classification")

tune_data <- Xtr_df %>% mutate(readmitted = factor(y_train, levels = c(0, 1)))
xgb_wf <- workflow() %>% add_model(xgb_spec) %>% add_formula(readmitted ~ .)
skf <- vfold_cv(tune_data, v = 3, strata = readmitted)

xgb_param <- extract_parameter_set_dials(xgb_wf) %>%
  update(
    trees      = trees(range = c(100L, 400L)),
    tree_depth = tree_depth(range = c(3L, 8L)),
    learn_rate = learn_rate(range = c(-2, log10(0.3))),
    sample_size = sample_prop(range = c(0.5, 1.0)),
    min_n      = min_n(range = c(5L, 30L))
  )

10. Methods Narrative (Template)

Machine Learning Methods
We split the data temporally: training (2019–2021, N=XXX), validation (2022, N=XXX), and test (2023, N=XXX) to simulate prospective deployment. All preprocessing (median imputation, standardisation, one-hot encoding) was fit exclusively on training data to prevent leakage.
We evaluated four candidate models: logistic regression (L2), random forest, gradient boosting (GBM), and XGBoost. The GBM was selected based on validation AUC and further tuned with 20-iteration Bayesian optimisation (tune::tune_bayes). Predicted probabilities were recalibrated on the validation set using Platt scaling; calibration was assessed visually and via Brier score.
Discrimination was quantified by AUC-ROC and Average Precision (AUC-PR), both with 1000-sample bootstrap 95% CIs. Clinical utility was assessed by Decision Curve Analysis at thresholds 1–50%. Model explanations were generated with fastshap and DALEX; global importance was summarised by mean |SHAP value| and local explanations were produced for high-risk patients.
The final model was serialised and a feature drift template implemented to monitor input distribution shifts in production. EPV = XX (events per variable), confirming adequate sample size for the XX-feature model.
All analyses used R 4.3+ (tidymodels, ranger, xgboost, lightgbm, DALEX, fastshap).

set.seed(42); N <- 3000
clip <- function(x, lo, hi) pmin(pmax(x, lo), hi)
b <- matrix(rnorm(N * 4), ncol = 4); set.seed(99)
age <- as.integer(clip(rnorm(N, 62, 15), 18, 92))
sex <- sample(c("M", "F"), N, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.48, 0.52))
payer <- sample(c("Medicare", "Medicaid", "Private", "Self-pay", "Other"),
                N, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.40, 0.22, 0.28, 0.07, 0.03))
admit_type <- sample(c("Emergency", "Elective", "Urgent"),
                     N, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.52, 0.30, 0.18))
los_days <- as.integer(clip(round(rgamma(N, shape = 2.5, scale = 1.8)), 1, 30))
diabetes <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.6 * b[, 1] - 0.5))
hypertension <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.7 * b[, 1] - 0.2))
hf <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.4 * b[, 2] + 0.5 * hypertension - 1.5))
copd <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.5 * b[, 3] - 1.0))
ckd <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.5 * b[, 1] + 0.6 * diabetes - 1.2))
obesity <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.5 * b[, 1] - 0.8))
depression <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.3 * b[, 4] - 1.4))
n_comorb <- diabetes + hypertension + hf + copd + ckd
set.seed(21)
glucose <- round(clip(rnorm(N, 105 + 15 * diabetes, 28), 50, 400), 1)
creatinine <- round(clip(rgamma(N, shape = 1.6 + 0.8 * hf, scale = 0.6), 0.4, 10), 2)
hba1c <- round(clip(rnorm(N, 6.5 + 0.8 * diabetes, 1.4), 4, 14), 1)
sbp <- round(clip(rnorm(N, 128 + 12 * hypertension, 18), 80, 200), 0)
bmi <- round(clip(rnorm(N, 28 + 4 * obesity, 6), 15, 55), 1)
logit <- (-3.2 + 0.6 * hf + 0.5 * diabetes + 0.5 * ckd + 0.3 * copd +
            0.02 * (age - 62) / 15 +
            0.3 * as.integer(admit_type == "Emergency") +
            0.25 * as.integer(payer == "Medicaid") +
            0.2 * as.integer(los_days > 7) +
            0.5 * hf * diabetes + rnorm(N, 0, 0.25))
readmitted <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(logit))
df <- tibble(
  age, sex, payer, admit_type, los_days,
  diabetes, hypertension, hf, copd, ckd, obesity, depression, n_comorb,
  glucose, creatinine, hba1c, sbp, bmi, readmitted
)
df$los_gt7 <- as.integer(df$los_days > 7)
NUMERIC <- c("age", "los_days", "n_comorb", "glucose", "creatinine", "hba1c", "sbp", "bmi")
BINARY <- c("diabetes", "hypertension", "hf", "copd", "ckd", "obesity", "depression", "los_gt7")
CATEGORIC <- c("sex", "payer", "admit_type")
FEATURES <- c(NUMERIC, BINARY, CATEGORIC); TARGET <- "readmitted"

set.seed(42)
df_ml <- df %>%
  select(all_of(c(FEATURES, TARGET))) %>%
  mutate(readmitted = factor(readmitted, levels = c(0, 1)))
split <- initial_split(df_ml, prop = 0.80, strata = readmitted)
df_tr <- training(split); df_te <- testing(split)
rec <- recipe(readmitted ~ ., data = df_tr) %>%
  step_impute_median(all_of(NUMERIC)) %>%
  step_normalize(all_of(NUMERIC)) %>%
  step_impute_median(all_of(BINARY)) %>%
  step_impute_mode(all_of(CATEGORIC)) %>%
  step_dummy(all_of(CATEGORIC), one_hot = TRUE)
rec_prep <- prep(rec, training = df_tr)
Xtr_tbl <- bake(rec_prep, new_data = df_tr) %>% select(-readmitted)
Xte_tbl <- bake(rec_prep, new_data = df_te) %>% select(-readmitted)
Xtr <- as.matrix(Xtr_tbl); Xte <- as.matrix(Xte_tbl)

y_te <- as.integer(as.character(df_te$readmitted))
feat_nm <- colnames(Xtr)
X_te_named <- Xte_tbl
X_tr_named <- Xtr_tbl

model <- xgboost(
  data = Xtr, label = factor(y_tr, levels = c(0, 1)), nrounds = 200, max_depth = 4,
  eta = 0.05, subsample = 0.8, objective = "binary:logistic",
  verbose = 0
)

title: SHAP Explainability
text:
2. SHAP — Conceptual Foundation

SHAP value for feature \(j\) on observation \(i\): the average marginal contribution of feature \(j\) to the prediction, weighted over all possible subsets of features (from game theory’s Shapley values).

Properties: - Additivity: sum of all SHAP values = prediction − base rate - Consistency: if a feature contributes more in model A than B, its SHAP value is larger in A - Local accuracy: SHAP values exactly decompose each individual prediction

# ── Compute SHAP values (fastshap) + DALEX explainer ──────────────────────────
pred_fun <- function(object, newdata) {
  predict(object, as.matrix(newdata))
}

explainer <- DALEX::explain(
  model, data = as.data.frame(X_tr_named), y = y_tr,
  predict_function = pred_fun, label = "xgboost", verbose = FALSE
)

set.seed(42)
# Kernel-style SHAP via Monte Carlo (fastshap); nsim kept modest for tutorial speed
shap_vals <- fastshap::explain(
  model, X = as.data.frame(X_tr_named), newdata = as.data.frame(X_te_named),
  pred_wrapper = pred_fun, nsim = 30, adjust = TRUE
)
shap_mat <- as.matrix(shap_vals)

text:
1. Setup, Dataset & Models

library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(ranger)
library(xgboost)
library(pROC)
library(patchwork)
tidymodels_prefer()
set.seed(42)

mod04_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "mod04")
dir.create(mod04_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
theme_set(
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
)
col_blue <- "#2563EB"; col_red <- "#DC2626"; col_green <- "#16A34A"
col_navy <- "#1E3A8A"
colors_m <- c("Logistic Reg" = col_green, "Random Forest" = col_blue, "Grad Boosting" = col_red)

auc_prob   <- function(y, p) yardstick::roc_auc_vec(factor(y, levels = c(0, 1)), p, event_level = "second")
ap_prob    <- function(y, p) yardstick::pr_auc_vec(factor(y, levels = c(0, 1)), p, event_level = "second")
brier_prob <- function(y, p) mean((p - y)^2)

set.seed(42); N <- 3000
sig <- function(x) 1 / (1 + exp(-x))
clip <- function(x, lo, hi) pmin(pmax(x, lo), hi)
b <- matrix(rnorm(N * 4), ncol = 4); set.seed(99)
age <- as.integer(clip(rnorm(N, 62, 15), 18, 92))
sex <- sample(c("M", "F"), N, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.48, 0.52))
payer <- sample(c("Medicare", "Medicaid", "Private", "Self-pay", "Other"),
                N, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.40, 0.22, 0.28, 0.07, 0.03))
admit_type <- sample(c("Emergency", "Elective", "Urgent"),
                     N, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.52, 0.30, 0.18))
los_days <- as.integer(clip(round(rgamma(N, shape = 2.5, scale = 1.8)), 1, 30))
diabetes <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.6 * b[, 1] - 0.5 + 0.02 * (age - 62) / 15))
hypertension <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.7 * b[, 1] - 0.2))
hf <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.4 * b[, 2] + 0.5 * hypertension - 1.5))
copd <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.5 * b[, 3] - 1.0))
ckd <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.5 * b[, 1] + 0.6 * diabetes - 1.2))
obesity <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.5 * b[, 1] - 0.8))
depression <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.3 * b[, 4] - 1.4))
n_comorb <- diabetes + hypertension + hf + copd + ckd
set.seed(21)
glucose <- round(clip(rnorm(N, 105 + 15 * diabetes, 28), 50, 400), 1)
creatinine <- round(clip(rgamma(N, shape = 1.6 + 0.8 * hf, scale = 0.6), 0.4, 10), 2)
hba1c <- round(clip(rnorm(N, 6.5 + 0.8 * diabetes, 1.4), 4, 14), 1)
sbp <- round(clip(rnorm(N, 128 + 12 * hypertension, 18), 80, 200), 0)
bmi <- round(clip(rnorm(N, 28 + 4 * obesity, 6), 15, 55), 1)
logit <- (-3.2 + 0.6 * hf + 0.5 * diabetes + 0.5 * ckd + 0.3 * copd +
            0.02 * (age - 62) / 15 +
            0.3 * as.integer(admit_type == "Emergency") +
            0.25 * as.integer(payer == "Medicaid") +
            0.2 * as.integer(los_days > 7) +
            0.5 * hf * diabetes + rnorm(N, 0, 0.25))
readmitted <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(logit))
df <- tibble(
  age, sex, payer, admit_type, los_days,
  diabetes, hypertension, hf, copd, ckd, obesity, depression, n_comorb,
  glucose, creatinine, hba1c, sbp, bmi, readmitted
)
df$los_gt7 <- as.integer(df$los_days > 7)
NUMERIC <- c("age", "los_days", "n_comorb", "glucose", "creatinine", "hba1c", "sbp", "bmi")
BINARY <- c("diabetes", "hypertension", "hf", "copd", "ckd", "obesity", "depression", "los_gt7")
CATEGORIC <- c("sex", "payer", "admit_type")
FEATURES <- c(NUMERIC, BINARY, CATEGORIC); TARGET <- "readmitted"

set.seed(42)
df_ml <- df %>%
  select(all_of(c(FEATURES, TARGET))) %>%
  mutate(readmitted = factor(readmitted, levels = c(0, 1)))
sp_te  <- initial_split(df_ml, prop = 0.80, strata = readmitted)
df_tr_all <- training(sp_te); df_te <- testing(sp_te)
sp_cal <- initial_split(df_tr_all, prop = 0.80, strata = readmitted)
df_tr2 <- training(sp_cal); df_cal <- testing(sp_cal)

rec <- recipe(readmitted ~ ., data = df_tr2) %>%
  step_impute_median(all_of(NUMERIC)) %>%
  step_normalize(all_of(NUMERIC)) %>%
  step_impute_median(all_of(BINARY)) %>%
  step_impute_mode(all_of(CATEGORIC)) %>%
  step_dummy(all_of(CATEGORIC), one_hot = TRUE)
rec_prep <- prep(rec, training = df_tr2)
bake_x <- function(d) bake(rec_prep, new_data = d) %>% select(-readmitted)
Xtr_tbl <- bake_x(df_tr2); Xcal_tbl <- bake_x(df_cal); Xte_tbl <- bake_x(df_te)
Xtr <- as.matrix(Xtr_tbl); Xcal <- as.matrix(Xcal_tbl); Xte <- as.matrix(Xte_tbl)
y_tr2 <- as.integer(as.character(df_tr2$readmitted))
y_cal  <- as.integer(as.character(df_cal$readmitted))
y_te   <- as.integer(as.character(df_te$readmitted))

# Logistic regression (balanced weights)
w_lr <- ifelse(y_tr2 == 1, 0.5 / mean(y_tr2 == 1), 0.5 / mean(y_tr2 == 0))
lr <- glm(y ~ ., data = Xtr_tbl %>% mutate(y = y_tr2), family = binomial, weights = w_lr)

# Random forest
cw <- c("0" = 1 / mean(y_tr2 == 0), "1" = 1 / mean(y_tr2 == 1))
rf <- ranger(
  readmitted ~ ., data = Xtr_tbl %>% mutate(readmitted = factor(y_tr2, levels = c(0, 1))),
  probability = TRUE, num.trees = 200, max.depth = 10, class.weights = cw, seed = 42
)

# Gradient boosting via xgboost (parsnip analogue of GBM)
dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(Xtr, label = y_tr2)
gb <- xgb.train(
  params = list(objective = "binary:logistic", eval_metric = "auc",
                eta = 0.05, max_depth = 4, subsample = 0.8, seed = 42, verbosity = 0),
  data = dtrain, nrounds = 200, verbose = 0
)

fitted <- list("Logistic Reg" = lr, "Random Forest" = rf, "Grad Boosting" = gb)
probs <- list(
  "Logistic Reg"  = as.numeric(predict(lr, newdata = Xte_tbl, type = "response")),
  "Random Forest" = predict(rf, data = Xte_tbl)$predictions[, "1"],
  "Grad Boosting" = predict(gb, xgb.DMatrix(Xte))
)
cat("Models trained. Positive rate (test):", mean(y_te) * 100, "%\n")

Models trained. Positive rate (test): 10.64892 %

2. AUC-ROC and Precision-Recall with Bootstrap CIs

bootstrap_ci <- function(y_true, y_prob, metric_fn, n_boot = 1000, seed = 42) {
  set.seed(seed)
  n <- length(y_true)
  scores <- replicate(n_boot, {
    idx <- sample.int(n, n, replace = TRUE)
    metric_fn(y_true[idx], y_prob[idx])
  })
  quantile(scores, c(0.025, 0.975))
}

summary_rows <- list()
roc_all <- list(); pr_all <- list()
for (name in names(probs)) {
  prob <- probs[[name]]
  auc  <- auc_prob(y_te, prob)
  ap   <- ap_prob(y_te, prob)
  brier <- brier_prob(y_te, prob)
  auc_ci <- bootstrap_ci(y_te, prob, auc_prob)
  ap_ci  <- bootstrap_ci(y_te, prob, ap_prob)
  summary_rows[[name]] <- tibble(
    Model = name, AUC = auc,
    `AUC 95%CI` = sprintf("%.3f–%.3f", auc_ci[1], auc_ci[2]),
    `Avg Prec` = ap,
    `AP 95%CI` = sprintf("%.3f–%.3f", ap_ci[1], ap_ci[2]),
    Brier = brier
  )
  roc_all[[name]] <- yardstick::roc_curve(
    tibble(truth = factor(y_te, levels = c(0, 1)), .pred = prob),
    truth, .pred, event_level = "second"
  ) %>% mutate(Model = name, lab = sprintf("%s AUC=%.3f (%.3f–%.3f)",
                                           name, auc, auc_ci[1], auc_ci[2]))
  pr_all[[name]] <- yardstick::pr_curve(
    tibble(truth = factor(y_te, levels = c(0, 1)), .pred = prob),
    truth, .pred, event_level = "second"
  ) %>% mutate(Model = name, lab = sprintf("%s AP=%.3f (%.3f–%.3f)",
                                           name, ap, ap_ci[1], ap_ci[2]))
}

  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_path(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = colors_m) +

       title = "ROC Curves with Bootstrap 95% CI") +

3. Calibration Assessment & Recalibration

calib_bins <- function(y, p, n_bins = 10) {
  tibble(y = y, p = p) %>%
    mutate(bin = ntile(p, n_bins)) %>%
    group_by(bin) %>%
    summarise(mean_pred = mean(p), frac_pos = mean(y), .groups = "drop")
}

platt_calibrate <- function(p_fit, y_fit, p_new) {
  cal <- glm(y ~ p, data = tibble(y = y_fit, p = p_fit), family = binomial)
  as.numeric(predict(cal, newdata = tibble(p = p_new), type = "response"))
}
iso_calibrate <- function(p_fit, y_fit, p_new) {
  ord <- order(p_fit)
  iso <- isoreg(p_fit[ord], y_fit[ord])
  sf  <- as.stepfun(iso)
  pmin(pmax(sf(p_new), 0), 1)
}

calib_plots <- imap(probs, function(prob, name) {
  orig   <- calib_bins(y_te, prob)
  plat_p <- platt_calibrate(prob, y_te, prob)
  iso_p  <- iso_calibrate(prob, y_te, prob)
  d <- bind_rows(
    orig %>% mutate(method = "Uncalibrated"),
    calib_bins(y_te, plat_p) %>% mutate(method = "Platt (sigmoid)"),
    calib_bins(y_te, iso_p)  %>% mutate(method = "Isotonic")
  )
  brier_orig  <- brier_prob(y_te, prob)
  brier_platt <- brier_prob(y_te, plat_p)
  ggplot(d, aes(mean_pred, frac_pos, colour = method, shape = method)) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey30") +
    geom_point(size = 2) + geom_line() +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("Uncalibrated" = colors_m[[name]],
                                   "Platt (sigmoid)" = "#D97706",
                                   "Isotonic" = "#7C3AED")) +
    annotate("text", x = 0.05, y = 0.95,
             label = sprintf("Brier: %.3f→%.3f", brier_orig, brier_platt),
             hjust = 0, size = 3) +
    labs(x = "Mean predicted", y = "Fraction positives", title = name, colour = NULL, shape = NULL) +
    coord_equal(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1)) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
})

4. Decision Curve Analysis (DCA) — Net Benefit

net_benefit <- function(y_true, y_prob, threshold) {
  y_pred <- as.integer(y_prob >= threshold)
  tp <- sum(y_pred == 1 & y_true == 1)
  fp <- sum(y_pred == 1 & y_true == 0)
  n  <- length(y_true)
  odds <- threshold / (1 - threshold)
  (tp - fp * odds) / n
}

thresholds <- seq(0.01, 0.50, length.out = 100)
dca <- imap_dfr(probs, function(prob, name) {
  tibble(threshold = thresholds,
         nb = map_dbl(thresholds, ~ net_benefit(y_te, prob, .x)),
         Model = name)
})
nb_all <- tibble(
  threshold = thresholds,
  nb = map_dbl(thresholds, ~ net_benefit(y_te, rep(1, length(y_te)), .x)),
  Model = "Treat all"
)

ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = dca, aes(threshold, nb, colour = Model), linewidth = 1) +

best_prob <- probs[["Grad Boosting"]]
roc_df <- pROC::roc(y_te, best_prob, quiet = TRUE)
fpr <- 1 - roc_df$specificities
tpr <- roc_df$sensitivities
thrs <- roc_df$thresholds
# pROC thresholds are in decreasing score order; replace Inf/-Inf
thrs[is.infinite(thrs)] <- ifelse(thrs[is.infinite(thrs)] > 0, 1, 0)

pr_df <- yardstick::pr_curve(
  tibble(truth = factor(y_te, levels = c(0, 1)), .pred = best_prob),
  truth, .pred, event_level = "second"
)
precision_v <- pr_df$precision
recall_v    <- pr_df$recall
thrs_pr     <- pr_df$.threshold
thrs_pr[is.infinite(thrs_pr)] <- 1

# Three threshold strategies
youden_thr <- thrs[which.max(tpr - fpr)]
sens80_idx <- which(tpr >= 0.80)
thr_sens80 <- if (length(sens80_idx)) thrs[sens80_idx[1]] else 0.5
prec40_idx <- which(precision_v >= 0.40)
thr_prec40 <- if (length(prec40_idx)) thrs_pr[prec40_idx[1]] else 0.5

thresholds_clinical <- c(
  "Youden's J (balanced)" = youden_thr,
  "Sensitivity≥0.80"      = thr_sens80,
  "Precision≥0.40"        = thr_prec40
)

cat(sprintf("%-30s %10s %8s %8s %8s %8s\n",
            "Strategy", "Threshold", "Sens", "Spec", "PPV", "NPV"))

Strategy                        Threshold     Sens     Spec      PPV      NPV

cat(strrep("-", 70), "\n")

---------------------------------------------------------------------- 

for (strategy in names(thresholds_clinical)) {
  thr <- as.numeric(thresholds_clinical[[strategy]])
  y_pred <- as.integer(best_prob >= thr)
  tp <- sum(y_pred == 1 & y_te == 1); fp <- sum(y_pred == 1 & y_te == 0)
  tn <- sum(y_pred == 0 & y_te == 0); fn <- sum(y_pred == 0 & y_te == 1)
  sens <- tp / (tp + fn); spec <- tn / (tn + fp)
  ppv  <- if ((tp + fp) > 0) tp / (tp + fp) else 0
  npv  <- if ((tn + fn) > 0) tn / (tn + fn) else 0
  cat(sprintf("%-30s %10.3f %8.3f %8.3f %8.3f %8.3f\n",
              strategy, thr, sens, spec, ppv, npv))
}

1. Setup & Shared Dataset

library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(rpart)
library(rpart.plot)
library(ranger)
library(vip)

mod04_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "mod04")
dir.create(mod04_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
)
col_blue <- "#2563EB"; col_red <- "#DC2626"; col_green <- "#16A34A"
col_purple <- "#7C3AED"; col_navy <- "#1E3A8A"

auc_prob   <- function(y, p) yardstick::roc_auc_vec(factor(y, levels = c(0, 1)), p, event_level = "second")
ap_prob    <- function(y, p) yardstick::pr_auc_vec(factor(y, levels = c(0, 1)), p, event_level = "second")
brier_prob <- function(y, p) mean((p - y)^2)

# ── Dataset (same seed as NB-01) ──────────────────────────────────────────────
set.seed(42); N <- 3000
sig <- function(x) 1 / (1 + exp(-x))
clip <- function(x, lo, hi) pmin(pmax(x, lo), hi)
b <- matrix(rnorm(N * 4), ncol = 4); set.seed(99)
age <- as.integer(clip(rnorm(N, 62, 15), 18, 92))
sex <- sample(c("M", "F"), N, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.48, 0.52))
payer <- sample(c("Medicare", "Medicaid", "Private", "Self-pay", "Other"),
                N, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.40, 0.22, 0.28, 0.07, 0.03))
admit_type <- sample(c("Emergency", "Elective", "Urgent"),
                     N, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.52, 0.30, 0.18))
los_days <- as.integer(clip(round(rgamma(N, shape = 2.5, scale = 1.8)), 1, 30))
diabetes <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.6 * b[, 1] - 0.5 + 0.02 * (age - 62) / 15))
hypertension <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.7 * b[, 1] - 0.2))
hf <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.4 * b[, 2] + 0.5 * hypertension - 1.5))
copd <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.5 * b[, 3] - 1.0))
ckd <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.5 * b[, 1] + 0.6 * diabetes - 1.2))
obesity <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.5 * b[, 1] - 0.8))
depression <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.3 * b[, 4] - 1.4))
n_comorb <- diabetes + hypertension + hf + copd + ckd
set.seed(21)
glucose <- round(clip(rnorm(N, 105 + 15 * diabetes, 28), 50, 400), 1)
creatinine <- round(clip(rgamma(N, shape = 1.6 + 0.8 * hf, scale = 0.6), 0.4, 10), 2)
hba1c <- round(clip(rnorm(N, 6.5 + 0.8 * diabetes, 1.4), 4, 14), 1)
sbp <- round(clip(rnorm(N, 128 + 12 * hypertension, 18), 80, 200), 0)
bmi <- round(clip(rnorm(N, 28 + 4 * obesity, 6), 15, 55), 1)
logit <- (-3.2 + 0.6 * hf + 0.5 * diabetes + 0.5 * ckd + 0.3 * copd +
            0.02 * (age - 62) / 15 +
            0.3 * as.integer(admit_type == "Emergency") +
            0.25 * as.integer(payer == "Medicaid") +
            0.2 * as.integer(los_days > 7) +
            0.5 * hf * diabetes + rnorm(N, 0, 0.25))
readmitted <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(logit))
df <- tibble(
  age, sex, payer, admit_type, los_days,
  diabetes, hypertension, hf, copd, ckd, obesity, depression, n_comorb,
  glucose, creatinine, hba1c, sbp, bmi, readmitted
)
df$los_gt7 <- as.integer(df$los_days > 7)
NUMERIC <- c("age", "los_days", "n_comorb", "glucose", "creatinine", "hba1c", "sbp", "bmi")
BINARY <- c("diabetes", "hypertension", "hf", "copd", "ckd", "obesity", "depression", "los_gt7")
CATEGORIC <- c("sex", "payer", "admit_type")
FEATURES <- c(NUMERIC, BINARY, CATEGORIC); TARGET <- "readmitted"

# ── Preprocessing + split ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
set.seed(42)
df_ml <- df %>%
  select(all_of(c(FEATURES, TARGET))) %>%
  mutate(readmitted = factor(readmitted, levels = c(0, 1)))
split <- initial_split(df_ml, prop = 0.80, strata = readmitted)
df_tr <- training(split); df_te <- testing(split)
y_tr <- as.integer(as.character(df_tr$readmitted))
y_te <- as.integer(as.character(df_te$readmitted))

rec <- recipe(readmitted ~ ., data = df_tr) %>%
  step_impute_median(all_of(NUMERIC)) %>%
  step_normalize(all_of(NUMERIC)) %>%
  step_impute_median(all_of(BINARY)) %>%
  step_impute_mode(all_of(CATEGORIC)) %>%
  step_dummy(all_of(CATEGORIC), one_hot = TRUE)
rec_prep <- prep(rec, training = df_tr)
Xtr_tbl <- bake(rec_prep, new_data = df_tr) %>% select(-readmitted)
Xte_tbl <- bake(rec_prep, new_data = df_te) %>% select(-readmitted)
Xtr <- as.matrix(Xtr_tbl); Xte <- as.matrix(Xte_tbl)
feat_names <- colnames(Xtr)
cat(sprintf("Train: %d x %d | Test: %d x %d | Positive rate: %.1f%%\n",
            nrow(Xtr), ncol(Xtr), nrow(Xte), ncol(Xte), mean(y_tr) * 100))

3. Bias-Variance Tradeoff — Tree Depth Experiment

set.seed(42)
depths <- 1:20
skf <- vfold_cv(dt_data, v = 5, strata = readmitted)

cv_at_depth <- function(d) {
  map_dbl(skf$splits, function(sp) {
    tr <- analysis(sp); te <- assessment(sp)
    w  <- ifelse(tr$readmitted == "1", 0.5 / mean(tr$readmitted == "1"),
                 0.5 / mean(tr$readmitted == "0"))
    fit <- rpart(readmitted ~ ., data = tr, method = "class", weights = w,
                 control = rpart.control(maxdepth = d, minsplit = 20, cp = 0, xval = 0))
    p <- predict(fit, newdata = te, type = "prob")[, "1"]
    auc_prob(as.integer(as.character(te$readmitted)), p)
  }) %>% mean()
}

test_aucs <- map_dbl(depths, cv_at_depth)
best_depth <- depths[which.max(test_aucs)]

depth_df <- tibble(depth = depths, cv_auc = test_aucs)
ggplot(depth_df, aes(depth, cv_auc)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = cv_auc - 0.01, ymax = cv_auc + 0.01), fill = col_navy, alpha = 0.10) +
  geom_line(colour = col_navy, linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(colour = col_navy, size = 2) +

5. Feature Importance — MDI vs Permutation

    Xp <- Xte_tbl
    Xp[[col]] <- sample(Xp[[col]])
    base_auc - auc_prob(y_te, predict(rf, data = Xp)$predictions[, "1"])
  })
  tibble(feature = col, importance = mean(drops))
}) %>% arrange(desc(importance)) %>% slice_head(n = 15)

8. Knowledge Check

Why does a single deep decision tree overfit while a random forest with deep trees does not?

logistic <- function(x) 1 / (1 + exp(-x))
N <- 2500
base <- matrix(rnorm(N * 4), ncol = 4)

set.seed(99)

# ── Covariates ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
age           <- as.integer(pmin(pmax(rnorm(N, 62, 15), 18), 92))
sex           <- sample(c("M", "F"), N, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.48, 0.52))
payer         <- sample(
  c("Medicare", "Medicaid", "Private", "Self-pay", "Other"),
  N, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.40, 0.22, 0.28, 0.07, 0.03)
)
diabetes      <- rbinom(N, 1, logistic(0.6 * base[, 1] - 0.5 + 0.02 * (age - 62) / 15))
hypertension  <- rbinom(N, 1, logistic(0.7 * base[, 1] - 0.2))
hf            <- rbinom(N, 1, logistic(0.4 * base[, 2] + 0.5 * hypertension - 1.5))
copd          <- rbinom(N, 1, logistic(0.5 * base[, 3] - 1.0))
los_days      <- as.integer(pmin(pmax(rgamma(N, shape = 2.5, scale = 1.8), 1), 30))
admit_type    <- sample(c("Emergency", "Elective", "Urgent"), N, replace = TRUE,
                        prob = c(0.52, 0.30, 0.18))
n_comorb      <- diabetes + hypertension + hf + copd

# ── Outcomes ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
readmit_logit <- (-3.0 + 0.5 * diabetes + 0.7 * hf + 0.8 * diabetes * hf  # interaction
                  + 0.3 * copd + 0.02 * (age - 62) / 15
                  + 0.3 * as.integer(admit_type == "Emergency")
                  + 0.25 * as.integer(payer == "Medicaid")
                  + 0.2 * as.integer(los_days > 7) + rnorm(N, 0, 0.25))
readmitted    <- rbinom(N, 1, logistic(readmit_logit))

# Survival: time to readmission
hazard      <- exp(-3.8 + 0.5 * hf + 0.3 * diabetes + 0.15 * (los_days > 7))
surv_days   <- as.integer(pmin(pmax(rexp(N, rate = hazard), 1), 365))
censor_time <- as.integer(round(runif(N, 30, 365)))
event_obs   <- as.integer(surv_days <= censor_time)
duration    <- ifelse(event_obs == 1, surv_days, censor_time)

# ED visits (NB distributed)
log_mu_ed <- (-0.3 + 0.5 * diabetes + 0.8 * hf + 0.4 * copd + 0.02 * (age - 62) / 15 + log(2))
ed_visits <- rnbinom(N, size = 2, mu = exp(log_mu_ed))

df <- tibble(
  patient_id     = sprintf("PT-%05d", seq_len(N)),
  age            = age,
  age_std        = (age - 62) / 15,
  sex            = sex,
  payer          = relevel(factor(payer), ref = "Private"),
  admit_type     = relevel(factor(admit_type), ref = "Elective"),
  los_days       = los_days,
  los_gt7        = as.integer(los_days > 7),
  diabetes       = diabetes,
  hypertension   = hypertension,
  hf             = hf,
  copd           = copd,
  n_comorb       = n_comorb,
  readmitted     = readmitted,
  duration_days  = duration,
  event_observed = event_obs,
  ed_visits      = ed_visits,
  log_follow_up  = log(2)
) |>
  mutate(
    age_group = cut(age, breaks = c(17, 44, 64, 74, 95),
                    labels = c("18-44", "45-64", "65-74", "75+"))
  )

wilson_ci <- function(k, n) {
  z <- qnorm(0.975); p <- k / n; den <- 1 + z^2 / n
  mid <- (p + z^2 / (2 * n)) / den
  hw  <- (z * sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n + z^2 / (4 * n^2))) / den
  c(round((mid - hw) * 100, 1), round((mid + hw) * 100, 1))
}

}))

7. Sensitivity Analysis — E-Values

e_value <- function(RR) {
  if (RR < 1) RR <- 1 / RR
  RR + sqrt(RR * (RR - 1))
}
or_to_rr <- function(OR, prev) OR / ((1 - prev) + prev * OR)
prev <- mean(df$readmitted)

get_or <- function(model, name) {
  cf <- coef(model)
  if (name %in% names(cf)) exp(unname(cf[[name]])) else NA_real_
}

cat("E-value sensitivity analysis\n")

  list("HF (adj OR)", get_or(best_model, "hf")),
  list("diabetes:hf (adj OR)", get_or(best_model, "diabetes:hf"))
)) {
  label <- pair[[1]]; OR_val <- pair[[2]]
  if (is.na(OR_val) || OR_val <= 0) next
  rr <- or_to_rr(OR_val, prev)
  ev <- e_value(rr)
  cat(sprintf("  %-30s: adj OR=%.2f, E-value=%.2f\n", label, OR_val, ev))

text:
9. Methods Narrative Draft

Statistical Methods (Module 03 Capstone)
Continuous variables were summarised as mean ± SD or median [IQR] based on the D’Agostino skewness test; categorical variables as N (%). Group differences were assessed with Mann-Whitney U (skewed continuous) or chi-square tests (categorical).
Unadjusted odds ratios (OR) with 95% confidence intervals (CI) were derived from 2×2 contingency tables using the log method. Multivariable-adjusted ORs were estimated via logistic regression. Model selection followed the 10% change rule for confounding: a predictor was retained as a confounder if its inclusion changed the exposure OR by ≥10%. A likelihood ratio test was used to assess the diabetes × heart failure interaction.
Survival analysis used the Kaplan-Meier estimator with log-rank tests for group comparisons. Emergency department visit counts were modelled with negative binomial regression with a person-time offset; overdispersion was confirmed by the Cameron-Trivedi auxiliary test.
Model discrimination was assessed by the C-statistic (AUC-ROC); calibration by the Hosmer-Lemeshow test and calibration plot. Sensitivity to unmeasured confounding was quantified via E-values (VanderWeele & Ding, 2017). Multiple comparisons across five comorbidities were corrected using the Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate. All analyses were conducted in R 4.3+ (dplyr, stats, broom, survival, survminer, MASS).

  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(

      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()

logistic <- function(x) 1 / (1 + exp(-x))

set.seed(42)
N <- 1500
base <- matrix(rnorm(N * 3), ncol = 3)

set.seed(99)
ages          <- as.integer(pmin(pmax(rnorm(N, 58, 15), 18), 90))
sexes         <- sample(c("M", "F"), N, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.48, 0.52))
diabetes      <- rbinom(N, 1, logistic(0.6 * base[, 1] - 0.5))
heart_failure <- rbinom(N, 1, logistic(0.4 * base[, 2] - 1.2))
copd          <- rbinom(N, 1, logistic(0.5 * base[, 3] - 1.0))
mental_health <- rbinom(N, 1, logistic(0.3 * base[, 3] - 1.4))
payers        <- sample(
  c("Medicare", "Medicaid", "Private", "Self-pay"),
  N, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.38, 0.24, 0.30, 0.08)
)
follow_up_yrs <- round(runif(N, 0.5, 3.0), 2)  # Person-years of follow-up

# ED visits count: Poisson with mean depending on predictors
log_mu <- (-0.3 + 0.5 * diabetes + 0.8 * heart_failure + 0.6 * copd
           + 0.02 * (ages - 58) + 0.4 * mental_health
           + 0.3 * as.integer(payers == "Medicaid")
           + log(follow_up_yrs))             # offset for follow-up time
true_mu <- exp(log_mu)

# Overdispersed count (NB with dispersion)
ed_visits_pois <- rpois(N, true_mu)                          # Poisson
# nbinom: number of failures before `size` successes; p = size / (size + mu)
ed_visits_nb   <- rnbinom(N, size = 2, mu = true_mu)         # NegBin (overdispersed)

# Zero-inflated count (many true zeros)
zero_mask     <- rbinom(N, 1, 0.30)                     # 30% structural zeros
ed_visits_zip <- ifelse(zero_mask == 1, 0, ed_visits_pois)  # Zero-inflated

df <- tibble(
  patient_id     = sprintf("PT-%05d", seq_len(N)),
  age            = ages,
  sex            = sexes,
  payer          = relevel(factor(payers), ref = "Private"),
  diabetes       = diabetes,
  heart_failure  = heart_failure,
  copd           = copd,
  mental_health  = mental_health,
  follow_up_yrs  = follow_up_yrs,
  log_follow_up  = log(follow_up_yrs),
  ed_visits      = ed_visits_nb,      # primary outcome (overdispersed)
  ed_visits_pois = ed_visits_pois,    # comparison
  ed_visits_zip  = ed_visits_zip      # zero-inflated comparison
) |>
  mutate(age_std = as.numeric(scale(age)))

4. Testing for Overdispersion

overdispersion_test <- function(model_pois, df, outcome_col) {
  # Cameron-Trivedi auxiliary regression test for overdispersion.
  # H0: Var(Y) = μ  (equidispersion — Poisson OK)
  # H1: Var(Y) > μ  (overdispersion — use NB)
  mu_hat <- predict(model_pois, type = "response")
  y <- df[[outcome_col]]
  aux_y <- ((y - mu_hat)^2 - y) / mu_hat
  aux_model <- lm(aux_y ~ 0 + mu_hat)
  sm <- summary(aux_model)
  list(
    alpha = unname(coef(aux_model)[1]),
    t_stat = unname(sm$coefficients[1, "t value"]),
    p_val  = unname(sm$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|t|)"])
  )
}

# Fit Zero-Inflated Poisson via pscl if available
zip_ok <- requireNamespace("pscl", quietly = TRUE)
if (zip_ok) {
  zip_model <- pscl::zeroinfl(
    ed_visits_zip ~ age_std + diabetes + heart_failure + copd + mental_health +
      offset(log_follow_up) |
      age_std + diabetes + heart_failure + copd + mental_health,
    data = df, dist = "poisson"
  )
  cat("\nZero-Inflated Poisson — selected coefficients:\n")
  zip_count <- summary(zip_model)$coefficients$count
  zip_tid <- as.data.frame(zip_count) |>
    rownames_to_column("term") |>
    mutate(
      IRR = exp(Estimate),
      conf.low = exp(Estimate - 1.96 * `Std. Error`),
      conf.high = exp(Estimate + 1.96 * `Std. Error`)
    ) |>
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3)))
  print(zip_tid)
  cat(sprintf("\nAIC: %.1f\n", AIC(zip_model)))
} else {
  # Fallback: two-part hurdle-style sketch with glm (always runs)
  cat("\npscl not installed — hurdle-style two-part model instead.\n")
  df$any_ed <- as.integer(df$ed_visits_zip > 0)
  m_zero <- glm(
    any_ed ~ age_std + diabetes + heart_failure + copd + mental_health,
    data = df, family = binomial()
  )
  m_count <- glm(
    ed_visits_zip ~ age_std + diabetes + heart_failure + copd + mental_health,
    data = df |> filter(ed_visits_zip > 0), family = poisson(),
    offset = log_follow_up[df$ed_visits_zip > 0]
  )
  cat("Zero-process (logistic) ORs:\n")
  print(broom::tidy(m_zero, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE) |>
          filter(term != "(Intercept)"))
  cat("\nPositive-count Poisson IRRs:\n")
  print(broom::tidy(m_count, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE) |>
          filter(term != "(Intercept)"))
}

1. Setup & Dataset

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(broom)
library(MASS, exclude = "select")
library(tibble)
library(patchwork)

theme_set(
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
)

mod03_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "mod03")
dir.create(mod03_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

logistic <- function(x) 1 / (1 + exp(-x))

set.seed(42)
N <- 1200
base <- matrix(rnorm(N * 3), ncol = 3)

set.seed(99)
ages          <- as.integer(pmin(pmax(rnorm(N, 62, 16), 18), 95))
sexes         <- sample(c("M", "F"), N, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.48, 0.52))
payers        <- sample(
  c("Medicare", "Medicaid", "Private", "Self-pay", "Other"),
  N, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.40, 0.22, 0.28, 0.07, 0.03)
)
diabetes      <- rbinom(N, 1, logistic(0.6 * base[, 1] - 0.5))
heart_failure <- rbinom(N, 1, logistic(0.4 * base[, 2] - 1.2))
copd          <- rbinom(N, 1, logistic(0.5 * base[, 3] - 1.0))
admit_type    <- sample(c("Emergency", "Elective", "Urgent"), N, replace = TRUE,
                        prob = c(0.52, 0.30, 0.18))
n_comorb      <- diabetes + heart_failure + copd

# LOS with realistic predictors (right-skewed)
los_true <- (2.5 + 1.5 * heart_failure + 0.8 * diabetes + 0.5 * copd
             + 0.05 * ages + 0.6 * as.integer(admit_type == "Emergency")
             + rexp(N, rate = 1 / 1.5))
los_days <- as.integer(pmin(pmax(round(los_true), 1), 30))

# Total charge ~ LOS * daily rate (correlated)
charges <- pmax(
  round(los_days * runif(N, 1800, 4200) + 2000 * heart_failure + 1500 * diabetes + rnorm(N, 0, 3000), 2),
  500
)

df <- tibble(
  patient_id    = sprintf("PT-%05d", seq_len(N)),
  age           = ages,
  sex           = sexes,
  payer         = relevel(factor(payers), ref = "Private"),
  admit_type    = relevel(factor(admit_type), ref = "Elective"),
  diabetes      = diabetes,
  heart_failure = heart_failure,
  copd          = copd,
  n_comorb      = n_comorb,
  los_days      = los_days,
  total_charge  = charges
) |>
  mutate(
    age_std    = as.numeric(scale(age)),
    log_charge = log(total_charge),
    log_los    = log(los_days)
  )

cat(sprintf("Dataset: %d x %d\n", nrow(df), ncol(df)))

aug_m <- broom::augment(model_multi)
cooks_d <- cooks.distance(model_multi)

threshold <- 4 / nrow(df)
n_inf <- sum(cooks_d > threshold, na.rm = TRUE)

# LOWESS trend for residuals vs fitted
lowess_rf <- lowess(aug_m$.fitted, aug_m$.resid, f = 0.3)
lowess_sl <- lowess(aug_m$.fitted, sqrt(abs(std_resid)), f = 0.3)

p_diag_a <- ggplot(aug_m, aes(.fitted, .resid)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.2, size = 1.2, colour = "#2563EB") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "#DC2626", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_line(data = tibble(x = lowess_rf$x, y = lowess_rf$y),
            aes(x, y), inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "orange", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(x = "Fitted values", y = "Residuals",
       title = "A  Residuals vs Fitted\n(should be random scatter around 0)")

p_diag_b <- ggplot(aug_m, aes(sample = .resid)) +
  stat_qq(alpha = 0.4, size = 1, colour = "#2563EB") +
  stat_qq_line(colour = "#DC2626", linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(x = "Theoretical quantiles", y = "Sample quantiles",
       title = "B  QQ Plot of Residuals")

                   aes(fitted, sl)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.2, size = 1.2, colour = "#16A34A") +
  geom_line(data = tibble(x = lowess_sl$x, y = lowess_sl$y),
            aes(x, y), inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "orange", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(x = "Fitted values", y = "√|Standardised residuals|",
       title = "C  Scale-Location (homoscedasticity)\n(should be a flat line)")

# Compare models
glance_row <- function(model, name) {
  g <- broom::glance(model)
  tibble(
    Model          = name,
    `R²`           = g$r.squared,
    `Adj R²`       = g$adj.r.squared,
    AIC            = g$AIC,
    BIC            = g$BIC,
    `N predictors` = length(coef(model)) - 1
  )
}

title: Relative Risk, Odds Ratios & Confidence Intervals
text:
2. Core Measures from a 2×2 Table

measures_2x2 <- function(exposed, outcome, exposure_label = "Exposed", ci_method = "asymptotic") {
  # Compute RR, OR, ARR, and NNT with 95% CI from binary exposure and outcome.
  # Returns a tibble suitable for forest plots.
  a <- as.integer(sum(exposed == 1 & outcome == 1))  # exposed + event
  b <- as.integer(sum(exposed == 1 & outcome == 0))  # exposed + no event
  c <- as.integer(sum(exposed == 0 & outcome == 1))  # unexposed + event
  d <- as.integer(sum(exposed == 0 & outcome == 0))  # unexposed + no event
  n_e <- a + b; n_u <- c + d
  risk_e <- a / n_e; risk_u <- c / n_u

  # Point estimates
  ARR <- risk_e - risk_u          # absolute risk reduction (negative = harm)
  NNT <- if (ARR != 0) 1 / abs(ARR) else Inf
  RR  <- risk_e / risk_u
  OR  <- if (b * c > 0) (a * d) / (b * c) else NA_real_

  # 95% CI (delta method / log)
  z <- qnorm(0.975)
  se_log_rr <- sqrt((b / (a * n_e)) + (d / (c * n_u)))
  rr_lo <- exp(log(RR) - z * se_log_rr)
  rr_hi <- exp(log(RR) + z * se_log_rr)
  se_log_or <- sqrt(1 / a + 1 / b + 1 / c + 1 / d)
  or_lo <- exp(log(OR) - z * se_log_or)
  or_hi <- exp(log(OR) + z * se_log_or)
  se_arr <- sqrt(risk_e * (1 - risk_e) / n_e + risk_u * (1 - risk_u) / n_u)
  arr_lo <- ARR - z * se_arr
  arr_hi <- ARR + z * se_arr

  p_val <- chisq.test(matrix(c(a, b, c, d), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE))$p.value

  tibble(
    Exposure     = exposure_label,
    N_exposed    = n_e,
    N_unexposed  = n_u,
    Risk_exposed = round(risk_e * 100, 1),
    Risk_unexpos = round(risk_u * 100, 1),
    ARR_pct      = round(ARR * 100, 2),
    NNT          = round(NNT, 1),
    RR           = round(RR, 2),
    RR_lo        = round(rr_lo, 2),
    RR_hi        = round(rr_hi, 2),
    OR           = round(OR, 2),
    OR_lo        = round(or_lo, 2),
    OR_hi        = round(or_hi, 2),
    p_value      = round(p_val, 4)
  )
}

3. Bootstrap Confidence Intervals

bootstrap_rr_or <- function(exposed, outcome, n_boot = 2000, seed = 42) {
  # Bootstrap 95% CI for RR and OR — distribution-free.
  set.seed(seed)
  n <- length(exposed)
  rrs <- numeric(0); ors <- numeric(0)
  for (i in seq_len(n_boot)) {
    boot_idx <- sample.int(n, n, replace = TRUE)
    e <- exposed[boot_idx]
    o <- outcome[boot_idx]
    a <- sum(e == 1 & o == 1)
    b <- sum(e == 1 & o == 0)
    c <- sum(e == 0 & o == 1)
    d <- sum(e == 0 & o == 0)
    n_e <- a + b; n_u <- c + d
    if (n_e > 0 && n_u > 0 && a > 0 && c > 0 && b > 0 && d > 0) {
      rrs <- c(rrs, (a / n_e) / (c / n_u))
      ors <- c(ors, (a * d) / (b * c))
    }
  }
  rr_ci <- quantile(rrs, c(0.025, 0.975))
  or_ci <- quantile(ors, c(0.025, 0.975))
  list(rr_ci = rr_ci, or_ci = or_ci, rrs = rrs, ors = ors)
}

skewness <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  n <- length(x)
  m <- mean(x)
  s <- sd(x)
  if (n < 3 || s == 0) return(NA_real_)
  mean((x - m)^3) / (s^3)
}

logistic <- function(x) plogis(x)

# ── Full capstone dataset ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
N <- 1000
ages      <- as.integer(pmin(pmax(rnorm(N, 62, 16), 18), 95))
sexes     <- sample(c("M", "F"), N, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.48, 0.52))
payers    <- sample(c("Medicare", "Medicaid", "Private", "Self-pay", "Other"),
                    N, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.40, 0.22, 0.28, 0.07, 0.03))
drg_codes <- sample(c(470, 291, 392, 690, 871, 193, 247, 603), N, replace = TRUE)
drg_labels_map <- c(
  `470` = "Major joint replacement", `291` = "Heart failure & shock",
  `392` = "Esophagitis/misc GI",     `690` = "Kidney/UTI",
  `871` = "Septicemia",              `193` = "Simple pneumonia",
  `247` = "Perc cardiovasc w stent", `603` = "Cellulitis"
)
los_days <- as.integer(pmin(pmax(rgamma(N, shape = 2.5, scale = 1.8), 1), 30))
charges  <- round(los_days * runif(N, 1800, 4200), 2)
set.seed(99)
base <- matrix(rnorm(N * 3), ncol = 3)
diabetes      <- rbinom(N, 1, logistic(0.6 * base[, 1] - 0.5))
hypertension  <- rbinom(N, 1, logistic(0.7 * base[, 1] + 0.3 * base[, 2] - 0.2))
obesity       <- rbinom(N, 1, logistic(0.5 * base[, 1] + 0.4 * base[, 2] - 0.8))
ckd           <- rbinom(N, 1, logistic(0.5 * base[, 1] + 0.6 * diabetes - 1.2))
heart_failure <- rbinom(N, 1, logistic(0.4 * base[, 2] + 0.5 * hypertension - 1.5))
copd          <- rbinom(N, 1, logistic(0.5 * base[, 3] - 1.0))
n_comorbidities <- diabetes + hypertension + obesity + ckd + heart_failure + copd
readmit_logit <- -2.5 + 0.4 * heart_failure + 0.3 * ckd +
  0.2 * (n_comorbidities / 6) + 0.3 * (los_days > 7) + 0.2 * (payers == "Medicaid")
readmitted_30 <- rbinom(N, 1, logistic(readmit_logit))
admit_type <- sample(c("Emergency", "Elective", "Urgent", "Newborn"),
                     N, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.52, 0.30, 0.16, 0.02))
set.seed(21)
glucose    <- round(pmin(pmax(rnorm(N, 105, 28), 50), 400), 1)
creatinine <- round(pmin(pmax(rgamma(N, shape = 1.6, scale = 0.6), 0.4), 10), 2)
hba1c      <- round(pmin(pmax(rnorm(N, 6.8, 1.4), 4), 14), 1)

# Structured missingness
glucose[runif(N) < 0.08] <- NA_real_
creatinine[(payers == "Self-pay") & (runif(N) < 0.50)] <- NA_real_
creatinine[(payers != "Self-pay") & (runif(N) < 0.09)] <- NA_real_
charges[runif(N) < 0.07] <- NA_real_

start <- as.Date("2019-01-01")
set.seed(5)
n_days <- as.integer(as.Date("2023-12-31") - start)
admit_dates <- start + sample(0:(n_days - 1), N, replace = TRUE)

# ZIP codes (50 areas)
zip_codes  <- sprintf("%05d", 10000 + sample(0:49, N, replace = TRUE))
svi_by_zip <- setNames(rbeta(50, 2, 3), sprintf("%05d", 10000 + 0:49))
svi_scores <- unname(svi_by_zip[zip_codes])

df <- tibble(
  patient_id      = sprintf("PT-%05d", seq_len(N)),
  age             = ages,
  sex             = sexes,
  payer           = payers,
  drg_code        = drg_codes,
  drg_label       = unname(drg_labels_map[as.character(drg_codes)]),
  admit_type      = admit_type,
  los_days        = los_days,
  total_charge    = charges,
  diabetes        = diabetes,
  hypertension    = hypertension,
  obesity         = obesity,
  ckd             = ckd,
  heart_failure   = heart_failure,
  copd            = copd,
  n_comorbidities = n_comorbidities,
  glucose         = glucose,
  creatinine      = creatinine,
  hba1c           = hba1c,
  readmitted_30   = readmitted_30,
  admit_date      = as.Date(admit_dates),
  zip             = zip_codes,
  svi             = svi_scores
)
df$age_group   <- cut(df$age, breaks = c(17, 44, 64, 74, 95),
                      labels = c("18-44", "45-64", "65-74", "75+"))
df$admit_year  <- year(df$admit_date)
df$admit_month <- floor_date(df$admit_date, "month")

wilson_ci <- function(k, n, alpha = 0.05) {
  z <- qnorm(1 - alpha / 2); p <- k / n; den <- 1 + z^2 / n
  mid <- (p + z^2 / (2 * n)) / den
  hw  <- (z * sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n + z^2 / (4 * n^2))) / den
  c(round((mid - hw) * 100, 1), round((mid + hw) * 100, 1))
}

COMORBS <- c("diabetes", "hypertension", "obesity", "ckd", "heart_failure", "copd")

phi_coeff <- function(a, b) {
  ct <- table(a, b)
  if (!all(dim(ct) == c(2, 2))) return(0)
  n    <- sum(ct)
  chi2 <- suppressWarnings(chisq.test(ct)$statistic)
  sgn  <- sign(ct[2, 2] * ct[1, 1] - ct[1, 2] * ct[2, 1])
  as.numeric(sqrt(unname(chi2) / n) * sgn)
}

phi_m <- matrix(NA_real_, length(COMORBS), length(COMORBS),
                dimnames = list(COMORBS, COMORBS))
for (c1 in COMORBS) {
  for (c2 in COMORBS) {
    phi_m[c1, c2] <- phi_coeff(df[[c1]], df[[c2]])
  }
}

phi_heat <- as.data.frame(as.table(phi_m), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

text:
9. Analytic Narrative Draft

Methods (EDA section)
We conducted a comprehensive EDA of a synthetic hospital discharge cohort (N = 1,000) spanning 2019–2023. Continuous variables were summarised as mean ± SD or median [IQR] based on Shapiro-Wilk skewness assessment; categorical variables as N (%). Group comparisons used Mann-Whitney U tests for skewed continuous outcomes and chi-square tests for categorical variables.
Data quality assessment identified missing values in four variables: creatinine (high missingness in Self-pay patients, consistent with MAR mechanism), glucose (random, MCAR pattern), total charges, and HbA1c. All missing values were imputed using MICE (10 iterations, median initial strategy) with payer type included as an auxiliary variable.
Comorbidity co-occurrence was assessed using pairwise phi coefficients with hierarchical Ward clustering. A 10-condition network was constructed at a phi threshold of 0.15.
Geographic analysis aggregated 1,000 discharges to 50 ZIP code areas (minimum 5 discharges). Area-level readmission rates were correlated with CDC Social Vulnerability Index scores using Spearman rank correlation. A temporal decomposition of monthly admission counts used an additive seasonal model with a 12-month period.
All analyses were conducted in R 4.3+ using dplyr / tibble, stats, ggplot2, and tidymodels. Code and datasets are available at [GitHub repository].

3. Phi Coefficient Matrix (Strength of Association)

phi_coeff <- function(a, b) {
  # Phi coefficient for two binary variables.  Range: -1 to +1.
  ct <- table(a, b)
  if (!all(dim(ct) == c(2, 2))) return(0)
  n    <- sum(ct)
  chi2 <- suppressWarnings(chisq.test(ct)$statistic)
  sgn  <- sign(ct[2, 2] * ct[1, 1] - ct[1, 2] * ct[2, 1])
  as.numeric(sqrt(unname(chi2) / n) * sgn)
}

phi_matrix  <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(COMORBS), ncol = length(COMORBS),
                      dimnames = list(COMORBS, COMORBS))
pval_matrix <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(COMORBS), ncol = length(COMORBS),
                      dimnames = list(COMORBS, COMORBS))
for (c1 in COMORBS) {
  for (c2 in COMORBS) {
    phi_matrix[c1, c2] <- phi_coeff(df[[c1]], df[[c2]])
    if (c1 != c2) {
      pval_matrix[c1, c2] <- suppressWarnings(
        chisq.test(table(df[[c1]], df[[c2]]))$p.value
      )
    } else {
      pval_matrix[c1, c2] <- 1
    }
  }
}

5. Odds Ratios for Key Pairs

odds_ratio <- function(a, b) {
  # Odds ratio and 95% CI (Woolf method) for two binary variables.
  ct <- as.matrix(table(a, b))
  if (!all(dim(ct) == c(2, 2))) return(c(NA, NA, NA))
  # Apply 0.5 continuity correction if any cell is 0
  ct <- ct + 0.5
  OR <- (ct[2, 2] * ct[1, 1]) / (ct[1, 2] * ct[2, 1])
  log_or <- log(OR)
  se_log <- sqrt(1 / ct[1, 1] + 1 / ct[1, 2] + 1 / ct[2, 1] + 1 / ct[2, 2])
  lo <- exp(log_or - 1.96 * se_log)
  hi <- exp(log_or + 1.96 * se_log)
  round(c(OR, lo, hi), 2)
}

top_pairs <- phi_long %>%
  filter(significant) %>%
  arrange(desc(phi)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 8)

or_df <- top_pairs %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    or_ci = list(odds_ratio(df[[as.character(cond_1)]], df[[as.character(cond_2)]])),
    Pair  = paste(cond_1, "×", cond_2),
    Phi   = round(phi, 3),
    OR    = or_ci[1],
    lo    = or_ci[2],

  ) %>%

  `392` = "Esophagitis/misc GI",     `690` = "Kidney/UTI",
  `871` = "Septicemia",              `193` = "Simple pneumonia",
  `247` = "Perc cardiovasc w stent", `603` = "Cellulitis"
)
los_days   <- as.integer(pmin(pmax(rgamma(N, shape = 2.5, scale = 1.8), 1), 30))

                     N, replace = TRUE)

                     N, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.52, 0.30, 0.16, 0.02))

)

                    labels = c("18-44", "45-64", "65-74", "75+"))

# Use monthly series (requires ≥2 full periods)
ts_monthly <- ts(monthly$admissions, frequency = 12,
                 start = c(year(min(monthly$date)), month(min(monthly$date))))

  date     = monthly$date,
  Observed = as.numeric(decomp$x),
  Trend    = as.numeric(decomp$trend),
  Seasonal = as.numeric(decomp$seasonal),
  Residual = as.numeric(decomp$random)
) %>%
  pivot_longer(-date, names_to = "component", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(component = factor(component, levels = c("Observed", "Trend", "Seasonal", "Residual")))

library(tidyverse)

skewness <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  n <- length(x)
  m <- mean(x)
  s <- sd(x)
  if (n < 3 || s == 0) return(NA_real_)
  mean((x - m)^3) / (s^3)
}

2. Prevalence, Incidence & Rates

# ── 2.1  Comorbidity prevalence ──────────────────────────────────────────────
comorbidities <- c("diabetes", "hypertension", "ckd", "heart_failure")

wilson_ci <- function(k, n, alpha = 0.05) {
  z   <- qnorm(1 - alpha / 2)
  p   <- k / n
  den <- 1 + z^2 / n
  mid <- (p + z^2 / (2 * n)) / den
  hw  <- (z * sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n + z^2 / (4 * n^2))) / den
  c(round((mid - hw) * 100, 1), round((mid + hw) * 100, 1))
}

prev_df <- map_dfr(comorbidities, function(cond) {
  k <- sum(df[[cond]])
  n <- nrow(df)
  ci <- wilson_ci(k, n)
  tibble(
    Condition        = cond,
    `N cases`        = k,
    `Prevalence (%)` = round(k / n * 100, 1),
    `95% CI`         = sprintf("%s%%–%s%%", ci[1], ci[2])
  )
})

text:
5. Publication-Ready Table 1

table1 <- function(df, stratify, continuous, categorical) {
  groups <- sort(unique(na.omit(df[[stratify]])))
  records <- list()

  for (col in continuous) {
    sk <- abs(skewness(df[[col]]))
    use_median <- !is.na(sk) && sk > 1
    stat_label <- if (use_median) "median [IQR]" else "mean ± SD"
    row <- list(Variable = sprintf("%s (%s)", col, stat_label))
    for (g in groups) {
      vals <- df[[col]][df[[stratify]] == g]
      vals <- vals[!is.na(vals)]
      key  <- paste0(stratify, "=", g)
      if (use_median) {
        row[[key]] <- sprintf("%.1f [%.1f–%.1f]",
                              median(vals), quantile(vals, 0.25), quantile(vals, 0.75))
      } else {
        row[[key]] <- sprintf("%.1f ± %.1f", mean(vals), sd(vals))
      }
    }
    records <- append(records, list(row))
  }

  for (col in categorical) {
    records <- append(records, list(list(Variable = col)))
    cats <- sort(unique(na.omit(df[[col]])))
    for (cat in cats) {
      row <- list(Variable = paste0("  ", as.character(cat)))
      for (g in groups) {
        sub <- df[df[[stratify]] == g, ]
        n   <- sum(sub[[col]] == cat, na.rm = TRUE)
        pct <- n / nrow(sub) * 100
        row[[paste0(stratify, "=", g)]] <- sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n, pct)
      }
      records <- append(records, list(row))
    }
  }

  bind_rows(lapply(records, as_tibble))
}

6. Statistical Tests for Group Differences

cat("Statistical tests: readmitted vs not readmitted\n\n")

Statistical tests: readmitted vs not readmitted

# Mann-Whitney U — skewed continuous
for (pair in list(c("los_days", "LOS"), c("age", "Age"))) {
  col   <- pair[[1]]
  label <- pair[[2]]
  g0 <- df[[col]][df$readmitted_30 == 0]
  g1 <- df[[col]][df$readmitted_30 == 1]
  g0 <- g0[!is.na(g0)]
  g1 <- g1[!is.na(g1)]
  sk <- skewness(df[[col]])
  if (abs(sk) > 0.5) {
    wt <- wilcox.test(g0, g1, alternative = "two.sided", exact = FALSE)
    cat(sprintf("%s (skewed → Mann-Whitney U): U=%.0f, p=%.4f\n",
                label, wt$statistic, wt$p.value))
  } else {
    tt <- t.test(g0, g1)
    cat(sprintf("%s (normal → t-test): t=%.3f, p=%.4f\n",
                label, unname(tt$statistic), tt$p.value))
  }
}

              col, unname(chi$statistic), unname(chi$parameter), chi$p.value, sig))

# --- 3.2  ICD-10-CM parser ---
parse_icd10cm <- function(code) {
  # Parse an ICD-10-CM code into its structural components.
  # Returns a named list with chapter, category, subcategory, detail, and formatted code.
  code <- toupper(gsub("\\.", "", trimws(as.character(code))))
  if (!grepl("^[A-Z][0-9]{2}", code)) {
    return(list(
      valid = FALSE, formatted = NA_character_, chapter = NA_character_,
      category = NA_character_, subcategory = NA_character_,
      detail = NA_character_, specificity = NA_character_, raw = code
    ))
  }

  chapter     <- unname(icd10_chapters[substr(code, 1, 1)])
  if (is.na(chapter)) chapter <- "Unknown"
  category    <- substr(code, 1, 3)
  subcategory <- if (nchar(code) > 3) substr(code, 4, 4) else ""
  detail      <- if (nchar(code) > 4) substr(code, 5, nchar(code)) else ""
  formatted   <- paste0(category, if (nchar(code) > 3) paste0(".", substr(code, 4, nchar(code))) else "")
  spec_idx    <- min(nchar(code) - 3, 4) + 1
  specificity <- c("3-char", "4-char", "5-char", "6-char", "7-char")[spec_idx]

  list(
    valid       = TRUE,
    formatted   = formatted,
    chapter     = chapter,
    category    = category,
    subcategory = subcategory,
    detail      = detail,
    specificity = specificity,
    raw         = code
  )
}

# Test with a range of codes
test_codes <- c("E11.9", "I10", "N18.3", "J18.9", "A41.9", "M16.11", "Z87.891", "BADCODE")
for (c in test_codes) {
  parsed <- parse_icd10cm(c)
  if (isTRUE(parsed$valid)) {
    cat(sprintf("  %-10s → formatted: %-10s | chapter: %s\n",
                c, parsed$formatted, substr(parsed$chapter, 1, 40)))
  } else {
    cat(sprintf("  %-10s → INVALID CODE\n", c))
  }
}

# --- 4.2  CPT validator ---
validate_cpt <- function(code) {
  # Check if a CPT code is a valid 5-digit numeric string.
  code <- trimws(as.character(code))
  is_numeric_5 <- grepl("^[0-9]{5}$", code)
  code_int <- if (is_numeric_5) as.integer(code) else NA_integer_

  if (!is_numeric_5) {
    return(list(valid = FALSE, code = code, section = "Unknown", notes = "Not 5 digits"))
  }

  section <- "Unknown"
  if      (code_int >= 100   && code_int <= 1999)  section <- "Anaesthesia"
  else if (code_int >= 10004 && code_int <= 69990) section <- "Surgery"
  else if (code_int >= 70010 && code_int <= 79999) section <- "Radiology"
  else if (code_int >= 80047 && code_int <= 89398) section <- "Pathology/Lab"
  else if (code_int >= 90281 && code_int <= 99607) section <- "Medicine/E&M"

  list(valid = TRUE, code = code, section = section, notes = "")
}

  cat(sprintf("  %-8s → %-8s | section: %s\n", cpt, status, r$section))
}

5. LOINC Code Structure (Lab & Clinical Observations)
LOINC (Logical Observation Identifiers Names and Codes) standardises laboratory and clinical observations. Each code identifies a specific measurement.
Structure: NNNNN-C (5–6 digit numeric) + (1 digit check digit)
LOINC names follow a 6-part axis: 1. Component — what was measured (e.g. Glucose) 2. Property — type of quantity (e.g. MCnc = mass concentration) 3. Time aspect — Pt (point in time) vs 24H (24-hour) 4. System — specimen (e.g. Ser/Plas = serum/plasma) 5. Scale — Qn (quantitative), Ord (ordinal), Nom (nominal) 6. Method — analytical method (if relevant)

6. FHIR-Like JSON Parsing

# FHIR (Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources) is the modern HL7 standard
# for exchanging health data. Resources are JSON objects. Here we simulate
# a small FHIR Bundle containing Patient + Observation resources.

make_fhir_bundle <- function(n = 5) {
  # Generate a minimal FHIR-like bundle for n patients.
  loinc_sample <- loinc_ref %>% select(loinc, component, unit) %>% head(3)
  entries <- list()

  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    pt_id <- paste0("patient-", i)
    entries[[length(entries) + 1]] <- list(
      resourceType = "Patient",
      id           = pt_id,
      gender       = sample(c("male", "female"), 1),
      birthDate    = sprintf("%d-%02d-15", sample(1940:1984, 1), sample(1:12, 1)),
      address      = list(list(postalCode = as.character(sample(10000:99999, 1))))
    )
    for (j in seq_len(nrow(loinc_sample))) {
      lab <- loinc_sample[j, ]
      lo  <- loinc_ref$normal_low[loinc_ref$loinc == lab$loinc]
      hi  <- loinc_ref$normal_high[loinc_ref$loinc == lab$loinc]
      val <- round(runif(1, lo, hi), 2)
      entries[[length(entries) + 1]] <- list(
        resourceType  = "Observation",
        id            = paste0("obs-", pt_id, "-", lab$loinc),
        subject       = list(reference = paste0("Patient/", pt_id)),
        code          = list(coding = list(list(
          system  = "http://loinc.org",
          code    = lab$loinc,
          display = lab$component
        ))),
        valueQuantity = list(value = val, unit = lab$unit),
        status        = "final"
      )
    }
  }
  list(resourceType = "Bundle", type = "collection", entry = entries)
}
